description: Fragment of a late letter in Judaeo-Arabic and an erratic scribal hand. The address is to a certain David Medina. The final letter looks more like vav but ה seems possible based on its occurrences in the same line, especially כמה׳׳ר. Requires further examination.
description_he: קטע ממכתב מאוחר ביהודית-ערבית לדוד מ[...].
